NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 24, 11:26 AM ET

The Texans are the top-projected defense on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 8.3 DraftKings points for $3,400, against the Giants. Vikings (7.2, $3,500) and Broncos (7.1, $3,300) are next.

The Browns return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.53 projected points per $1,000 at $2,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 24, 11:26 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 7

Texans, HOU vs NYG ($3,400)

Texans carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.3 DraftKings points at $3,400. That is 1.2 points clear of Vikings. The salary works out to 2.46 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 7 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Texans averaged 8.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.3, and it holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Houston is a 10-point favorite at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 26.25 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Browns, CLE at TEN ($2,800)

Browns projects for 7.1 DraftKings points at $2,800, which works out to 2.53 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 7 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Browns averaged 7.1 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.7, and it holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cleveland is a 2.5-point favorite on the road against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 19.5 in a game totaled at 36.5.
